scope: Standing 1917 valve house on the reservoir side of the crest, including its projecting platform, granite cornice, arched openings and metal catwalks.
geometryBasis: Official monument polygon 895 and the named OSM valve-house rectangle agree to local surveying tolerance. The surveyed shore and separate dam scene set the base.
sectionBasis: Rectangular rusticated granite house with flat moulded coping, arched openings, blocked road-facing windows and projecting metal catwalks over the reservoir-side face.
limitations: The model follows the dual mapped footprint. Roof height, the position and number of individual openings and the catwalk dimensions are estimates.
The original 5 m terrain and the native road axis constrain the adjacent crest. The pier masonry and water-side foundation level are approximate.

facts.roof: flat with molded projecting cornice and coping

facts.sitting: on a projecting platform near the south end of the dam
